legal.footerText: India-first career tools for clear resumes and organised applications.
legal.about:
# About CVTara

CVTara helps job seekers organise their experience, build resumes and cover letters, and track applications.

## Our approach

Clear layouts, truthful experience and useful guidance. Resume editing and profile drafts are available without a purchase.

## Contact

Use our Contact page for support and business enquiries.
